title: Self-reference and emotional reaction drive aesthetic judgment
authors: Salgues, S., Jacquot, A., Makowski, D., Tahar, C., Baekeland, J., Arcangeli, M., Dokic, J., Piolino, P., & Sperduti, M.
summary: What makes something beautiful to a particular person. This study separates two candidate drivers of aesthetic judgment — how self-relevant the work feels, and how strong an emotional reaction it produces — and reports both of them contributing.
